_comment: devkit check dependencies baseline: violations that existed when DEP-02..05 arrived. key = RULE|path|name, value = occurrences, and a reason for each. New ones FAIL; an entry that no longer occurs FAILS until removed. Regenerate with `devkit check dependencies --update-baseline` after a fix, never to admit a new one.

reasons.DEP-02|.github/workflows/reusable-ci.yml: the ansible-core test matrix installs each supported minor's latest patch by design; the matrix input is validated against ^X.Y$ first
devkit at this reusable workflow's own exact commit (job.workflow_sha, checked against 40 hex), so the checks and the workflow cannot disagree
reasons.DEP-02|.github/workflows/reusable-releas: the release builds with the latest patch of the declared ansible-core minor, validated against ^X.Y$ first
